+The `vagrant` module shows the currently installed version of Vagrant.
+The module will be shown if any of the following conditions are met:
+

+

body:
We have been changing the default format string to handle failures if fetching the version fails for some other reason more gracefully.
```suggestion
| `format`   | `"via [$symbol($version )]($style)"` | The format for the module.                          |
```

Same as above
```suggestion
        let expected = Some(format!("via {}", Color::Cyan.bold().paint("⍱ v2.2.10 ")));
```
I do not understand exactly why we need to append whitespace at the end of the version: `Color::Cyan.bold().paint("⍱ v2.2.10 ")` 🤔

It's because with the format string change, the space at the end is covered by the `$style`. I believe that `$style`/`Color::paint` both append and prepend values to the string which is why the space needs to be added to styled part of the string.
